purpose: Test whether likelihood-based clustered-binomial inference is sufficiently calibrated to justify a later constrained-null bootstrap implementation.

model.sampling_model: beta-binomial with cell-specific marginal probability and ICC
model.one_sample_test: signed-root profile likelihood ratio against the boundary probability
model.two_sample_NI_test: signed-root profile likelihood ratio with separate cell ICCs and constrained null FNR(comparison)-FNR(reference)=0.03

robustness_screen.generator_2: two-point random-probability cluster mixture matched to the same marginal probability and ICC, deliberately misspecified relative to the beta-binomial likelihood

decision_rule: Do not freeze profile-LR inference from this screen. If both correctly specified and misspecified generators are promising, implement constrained-null parametric bootstrap and repeat calibration before power sizing.
